reason: r3 replaces r2's tap-window hook with the three code patches of clarkekoko's "Lock-on Target MHGU Recomp" cheat, applied through Forge after exact-byte checks. A tap of the target-camera button turns the lock off or on; while on, only the single-tap target request (bit 0) is raised every frame, never bit 24, which r2 also raised.
runtime_test: r3 has not run. The user ran the cheat itself and found it better than r2: "didnt ruin aiming". r2 was accepted on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3 (EVIDENCE.json).
